title: Prediction of Water Resistance of Magnesium Oxychloride Cement Concrete Based upon Hybrid-BP Neural Network
summary: PSO/GWO/WOA-optimized BP networks predict water resistance of magnesium oxychloride concrete from 144 samples, split 100/22/22; reported test R² up to .99 and RMSE .73 for compressive strength and .62 for softening coefficient. This is a measured-material property prediction. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
